description: Heat Action Plan Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by North Carolina Office of Recovery and Resiliency; NOAA, Carolinas Climate Adaptation Partnership. With climate change driving more frequent and intense heat events, the State of North Carolina's Heat Action Plan Toolkit aims to help communities adapt and build resilience to extreme heat. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat. Assets: People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
